pi_analysis.sub_finding: 2 of 3 windows met the 36.2us SPREAD requirement (15.2us and 25.3us) -- the first sub-requirement spreads recorded anywhere in this direction -- but both were excluded by the utilisation criterion, whose measured span CONTAINS the measurement's own CPU time.
pi_analysis.instrument_flaw_is_pi_owned: the util<0.25 window criterion was specified over a 200ms span containing the window (ep3 pre-reg §5), so the measurement's own ~19ms of CPU (~10% of the span) counts against its own admission; a workload cannot pass a gate that charges it for its own execution.
pi_analysis.verdict_note: pre-registered verdict stands as NO-ADMISSION-QUIET-CORE; it may NOT be reinterpreted as ADMITTED after the fact. Resolving the tension requires a NEW pre-registration with a corrected instrument (utilisation excluding this cgroup's own CPU), stated in advance, and whose result cannot retroactively change this one.
